title: Exact Maximum Influence Under a Logarithmic Size Bound
statement: Let $w\ge 4$, and consider the critical tribes Boolean function on its critical dimension, with target value $-1$. For every set $J$ of coordinates whose size is at most the base-$2$ logarithm rounded up of that dimension, its coalitional influence toward $-1$ is at most $1/2+d_w$, where $d_w$ is the function's probability deficit from $1/2$; moreover, some such set has size exactly $w$ and attains this bound.
hypotheses_covered: Block width $w$ is a natural number
The coordinate set has size at most the ceiling of the base-$2$ logarithm of the critical dimension
The maximizing coordinate set has size exactly $w$ and also satisfies that logarithmic size bound
